clips.text: Not every style of play equates to winning. Certain guys can get 30 and their team would lose every single night. The NBA is in the business of letters, not numbers, meaning wins and losses. Not numbers, meaning, 'Oh, you are averaging 25.' People got to score, but the way that you play, is it conducive to winning? Right? Here is an example, Darius Garland. My guy is averaging, what is he averaging, 25 points right now? 26. So he is averaging 26 and their team is losing almost every single night. So is that a Darius Garland problem or is that a what is built around Darius Garland? Right? Okay, think about Jalen Brunson or Anthony Edwards. They go, 'Hey, you are scoring all the time. You are successful, but we cannot win until we take the ball out of your hands and everyone else is a threat too.' Having one sniper is different than having five. So you have to empower a team. And a lot of guys think that like, 'Oh, because I am not averaging 26, it is because those are bad 26. Those are rice cake 26.' You got to score that equates to winning. And then you can score all the points you want.

clips.speaker: Chris Mannix
clips.text: The situation involving Gary Trent Jr. is still a front-burner issue for the NBA. If you remember, Gary Trent Jr. had a couple of middling seasons with Milwaukee, one bad one a year ago, and the Bucks turned around and gave him a four-year, $64 million contract, which was crazy because they did it late in the cycle and to my knowledge there was no market for Gary Trent Jr. The supposition people are going with is that Gary Trent Jr. took short-term contracts from the Bucks cheaper, signed there to play with Giannis Antetokounmpo and Damian Lillard, and this is him being rewarded on the back end. A very Joe Smithian type of situation potentially developing in Milwaukee. To them, this is one of the most obvious cap circumvention examples of practically all time. There is no potential way that you could possibly explain or justify that contract. You can go through every reason, the apron system that they are in, who else was getting deals, and then just the player themselves. And then on top of that, they are not even playing him this year.
